name: Indian Hotels Company Ltd. (Taj, Vivanta, Ginger, Seleqtions)
business_summary: India's largest hospitality company (Taj, SeleQtions, Vivanta, Gateway, Ginger, Tree of Life brands) with an asset-light growth strategy (management contracts) and ~700-hotel portfolio target by FY27 (Business Standard, 22 Oct 2026). Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 2,566 cr (+21%); FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to 15-17%. Stock at 52-week high (Rs 868, +29.7% in 6m). Screener dossier unavailable, so margins and valuation are model knowledge.

exposures.mechanism: Rooms ~55% of revenue; premium/luxury supply is constrained so demand converts to ARR. +10% travel demand -> RevPAR +9% -> revenue +5% -> EBITDA +9% (high incremental margin ~65%, EBITDA margin ~36% model knowledge). EV/MCap ~1.0, persistence 0.5 -> ~+4.5.

evidence.note: IHCL Q2 FY27 revenue Rs2,566 cr (+21%), FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to 15-17% (+300 bp); 52-week high (Upstox, ET HospitalityWorld, Hotelier India)

exposures.mechanism: Corporate travel, weddings and MICE scale with GDP; +1pp GDP -> hospitality demand +2% -> EBITDA +4% (op leverage) -> persistence 0.5 -> +2; plus rerating of cyclicals +1.5.

evidence.note: IHCL Q2 FY27 revenue Rs2,566 cr (+21%), FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to 15-17% (+300 bp); 52-week high (Upstox, ET HospitalityWorld, Hotelier India)

exposures.mechanism: Luxury/upscale spending shift (domestic leisure, destination weddings) lifts ARR for Taj/Vivanta. Structural; +1 unit ~ +2% ARR with 80% flow-through -> EBITDA +4.5%; equity +3.

evidence.note: IHCL Q2 FY27 revenue Rs2,566 cr (+21%), FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to 15-17% (+300 bp); 52-week high (Upstox, ET HospitalityWorld, Hotelier India)

exposures.mechanism: Urban discretionary spend drives leisure/F&B/banquets; +5pp urban demand growth -> revenue +2.5% -> EBITDA +4% -> persistence 0.5 -> ~+2 plus sentiment.

evidence.note: IHCL Q2 FY27 revenue Rs2,566 cr (+21%), FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to 15-17% (+300 bp); 52-week high (Upstox, ET HospitalityWorld, Hotelier India)

exposures.mechanism: Escalation disrupts Gulf air hubs, raises airfares and cuts inbound/outbound travel; IHCL has Gulf/Middle East inbound feeder and its own Dubai/Doha/Riyadh management contracts. -1.2% revenue in affected quarter, EBITDA -2% plus risk-off beta 1.3 -> -2.5.
High-beta (1.3) consumer-cyclical; stock +17.9% in 1m on risk-on. +$5bn inflows -> +2.5 relative.
Low net debt, so funding cost minor; value is growth-duration (EV/EBITDA high-20s est.). +25bp -> -1.5 (damped 0.5).
Staff cost ~25% of revenue (incl. reimbursed managed-hotel cost). +2pp wages -> +0.5% of revenue; half passed via ARR/fees -> EBITDA -0.7% pre; persistence 0.5 -> -0.4; rounding -0.6.
Power and fuel ~6-7% of revenue; +10% Brent -> gas/LPG +5% -> +0.3% of revenue -> EBITDA -1%; plus airfares dent travel. Persistence 0.3 -> -0.3; with demand channel -0.8.
Foreign guests (~15-20% of hotel revenue USD-linked) and overseas hotels gain when INR weakens; +3% -> revenue +0.5% -> EBITDA +1.3% -> persistence 0.5 -> +0.6; some FPI sentiment drag offsets.
